attributes.long_name: Neighborhood probability of 6 hour precipitation above the 25 year average recurrence interval depth
attributes.comment: Threshold applies to the preceding 6 hours of accumulation. Published every 3 forecast hours from lead 6 hours. Neighborhood probability of 6 hour precipitation above the 25 year average recurrence interval depth. Probabilities compare precipitation with a spatially varying guidance or recurrence-interval depth. Negative values are unavailable thresholds blended into neighboring cells by smoothing; positive values near coverage boundaries can also be biased low. Mask values < -0.1.
